description: This is a Java interface defining the visitor pattern for entity condition objects within the Apache OFBiz framework. It declares methods for visiting different types of entity conditions such as expressions, conditions lists, and raw string conditions.

classes.name: EntityConditionVisitor
classes.description: An interface for visiting various entity condition objects in the visitor design pattern, allowing for extendable behavior when processing conditional expressions in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Dispatches the call to visit a specific type of EntityCondition such as EntityNotCondition, EntityConditionList, EntityFieldMap, EntityDateFilterCondition, EntityExpr, or EntityWhereString.
